name: @agent-ui/data
description: A zero-dependency, headless data layer for the fleet: a DataSource strategy interface whose CRUD verbs are optional capabilities, signal-backed resource()/mutation()/paginated(), a ./gateway consumer-side client contract (middleware onion, token flow, typed error envelope, retry/backoff, streaming pass-through), and a ./stream subpath carrying ONE Streamed<T> contract with fromFetchStream/fromEventSource/fromWebSocket adapters.
